Hi Samantha — thanks for the details and heads up. Short checklist from our side to onboard a US corporate vendor: 

1) Completed and signed W-9 (US persons) OR completed W-8BEN-E (foreign entities). The form determines 1099 eligibility.
2) Proof of EIN: IRS CP575 letter OR an official letter from your bank showing EIN on company account OR a copy of the filed SS-4 confirmation. A state certificate of incorporation plus EIN confirmation can work if CP575 not available.
3) Bank evidence: bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account name & routing, OR a voided check AND a bank statement showing the account ending in the last 4 digits. The bank letter must include bank contact for verification.
4) Beneficial owner questionnaire (if requested by payments compliance for entity-level screening).

We can send you a DocuSign W-9 link to sign and return; that speeds things up. If Biotrek is a Delaware C-Corp with a US EIN, you should provide a W-9. If you are a foreign entity, we'll need a W-8BEN-E plus a tax residency certificate.

If you can share the bank letter + COI now I can begin the pre-check; Finance will hold payment release until we have the signed W-9 and bank evidence. For expedites, flag the DocuSign as urgent.

DocuSign quick link (one-time): https://www.docusign.com/rec/ABC12345

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Manager, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf]

Appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments, Samantha. Because you're a US C-Corp with the EIN you provided, we will need a completed W-9. DocuSign link above will work — please sign and return.

Answers to your questions:
- Beneficial owner questionnaire: we request this for vendors where entity screening flags are present or when the payout amount exceeds $200k annually; otherwise it's optional. If your AP team can include a single-line beneficial owner confirmation (name + title + % ownership) that will speed any downstream checks.
- Bank letter: bank letterhead with bank contact is sufficient; notarization is not required unless the bank issues a statement that lacks contact details. The bank letter you attached looks fine at a glance — I'll forward to Finance for verification.

Action items:
- Samantha / AP: sign W-9 via DocuSign and return (link: https://www.docusign.com/rec/ABC12345).
- AP: confirm the account number last 4 digits in email for verification (do not send full account number).
- Karthik: kick off vendor onboarding once W-9 & bank letter are verified.

Cc'ing Laura (collections) and Vivek (payments) to prioritize release once the signed W-9 appears.

Best,
Karthik
